brand.tagline: Bridge the gap to the job that's coming.
home.kicker: Built in Dublin for Hack for Humanity
home.title: The work is changing. You can change with it.
home.sub: Tell us what you do in about 90 seconds. Get a calm, sourced read on your industry, the roles rising in it, and a dated plan to get there.
home.quote: A wish to switch jobs is a fantasy. A wish with a deadline is a goal. A goal with a plan is a strategy. Steady action on that strategy is success.
home.f1.d: Real news from the last 7 days, translated into what it means for you.
home.f2.d: New and changing roles matched to your experience, with an honest gap analysis.
home.f3.d: Weekly tasks, courses, fresh job alerts, LinkedIn posts and events, all in your calendar.
home.privacy: No account. No tracking. Your profile lives only in this browser.
home.powered: Runs on open-weight AI via DigitalOcean Gradient
